editorial:
Imagine being the only teacher who can see the rowdy spirits haunting a high school, and your job is to help them finally graduate. That is the fun setup here, mixing silly teen comedy with light fantasy. You follow a kind but overwhelmed teacher as he tries to connect with a group of ghosts who never finished school, and their unfinished business keeps causing chaos. The vibe is warm, goofy, and easy to enjoy, with plenty of jokes about school life and ghost rules. It never takes itself too seriously, so you can relax and laugh along.

The cast sells the jokes with big energy, and the pacing keeps things moving without dragging. Some jokes land better than others, and a few scenes feel predictable, but the heart keeps you invested. If you like feel-good comedies with a supernatural twist, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the teacher helps the ghosts complete their unfinished school goals, and they finally get to graduate in a sweet ceremony. The twist is that letting them move on also means saying goodbye, but their graduation frees the school from its haunting. You see the teacher realize his gift has a purpose, and the ghosts leave peacefully instead of causing more trouble. It ends on a warm, hopeful note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves light supernatural comedies and feel-good school stories.
